environment: **Organization**: None configured. Personal projects of a single maintainer (GitHub: sakuro).
**Source control**: github.com/sakuro and its repositories only; no other orgs are trusted by default.
**Repository visibility**: Varies per repository, many are public. Check visibility (e.g. via gh) before pushing or publishing anything that is not the repository's own work.
**Host containment**: None configured. Assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary macOS developer machine with open internet.
**Primary use of Claude Code**: Software development, plus maintaining personal dotfiles (~/.dotfiles, linked into ~/.config and ~/.claude).
**Org-specific CLIs**: mise (toolchain manager), gh (GitHub CLI), hk (git hook manager); routine invocations within a repository's working directory are expected developer workflow.
